description: This file defines the WPEFramework Plugin::Probe class, which includes nested classes for WebTransform, Listener, Broadcaster, and Instance. It appears to implement a network probe mechanism using Web requests over UDP datagrams, with functionality for sending, receiving, and processing SSDP-like messages, including signature validation. The file also declares methods for managing probe instances and their network communication.

classes.name: Probe
classes.description: Main class implementing network probing functionality with nested classes for WebTransform, Listener, Broadcaster, and Instance management.

classes.name: Probe::WebTransform
classes.description: Handles transformation of Web request data for network transmission.

classes.name: Probe::Listener
classes.description: Listens for incoming Web requests and responses over UDP datagrams, manages request validation and response creation.

classes.name: Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Sends SSDP-like multicast requests over UDP, manages destinations and request creation with optional security signatures.

classes.name: Probe::Instance
classes.description: Represents a discovered probe instance with URL, latency, model, and security status.
